description: This source file defines the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer class, which manages text-to-speech synthesis using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer. It includes methods to speak text asynchronously with timeout handling, stop speaking, and handle delegate callbacks for speech events.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class managing speech synthesis tasks asynchronously, providing start, stop, and timeout features using AVFoundation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and cancels any associated watchdog timers.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Asynchronously speaks provided text with optional language and on-start callback, implementing a timeout watchdog.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Calculates a timeout duration based on language-specific speech rate estimates with safety margins.

methods.name: matchesCurrentUtterance
methods.description: Checks if a given utterance ID matches the current utterance being spoken.

methods.name: handleFinish
methods.description: Handles the completion or cancellation of speech, resolving any pending continuations.

methods.name: finishCurrent
methods.description: Resets the current utterance state and resumes any pending continuation with success or error.
